blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte arrived at the Senate on Thursday as lawmakers tackled the proposed 2027 budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP). Duterte and her staff arrived as lawmakers prepared to scrutinize the proposed P785.2 million funding for her office.
